main.description: An account's hidden profile: one record, at key self in the owner's profile space (key profile, a memberspace with no members), listing the audiences that may see it. Only the owner and its serving app read the record; the serving app shows it, and serves its blobs, to anyone in a listed audience, and never shows the audience list to anyone but the owner and moderation. Others read it through tools.umbrae.actor.getProfile and getProfileBlob. The profile space's policy must pass the group rules (members published, not public) and its member list must be empty, or the profile shows to nobody. Clients keep audience entries they don't know when editing. Legacy (0.7.0 to 0.7.2): one copy per audience at self in a followers, group, everyone or community space, without audiences; read only until the owner has, or has deleted, a profile space. Blobs are fetched through space getBlob, never publicly.

pronouns.description: The short form, for readers that don't show sets. Kept in step with pronounSets.

pronounSets.description: The full pronoun sets, as in app.nearhorizon.actor.pronouns. Empty shows nothing, and hides the short form too.

pronounDisplayMode.description: Absent or unknown reads as all.

links.description: Profile links, as on the public profile. Readers hide duplicates and general-purpose URL shorteners.

audiences.description: Who may see the profile. Required in the profile space and forbidden elsewhere. Empty: the owner alone. Unknown types grant nothing.

icon.description: The site's icon, fetched through space getBlob.

followersAudience.description: The owner's approved followers: members of its followers space.

groupAudience.description: Members of one of the owner's own groups.

space.description: The group's space, in the at:space/ form.

communityAudience.description: Members of a community, while the owner is still a member.

space.description: The community's space, in the at:space/ form.
